limitations: Empirical reference is giant-dominated and contains faint neighbors; it is not an isolated calibrated PRF.
Subpixel interpolation ignores color, focus and intra-pixel response. Hypothesis diagonal chi-square values are sensitivity diagnostics, not decisive odds.
Whole-event bootstrap excludes reference-template systematic errors; mode/ROI variation is retained as a systematic test.
Relative empirical source offsets cancel absolute WCS bias but not proper-motion uncertainty or temporal image registration errors.
A putative unresolved companion to the giant shares the giant PSF: rejecting physical giant eclipses does not reject an unresolved faint source at that position.
